schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Dysart Unified School District dates for 2027–28, including the first and last days, major breaks, Monday early dismissal, K–8 conference half days, high school final exams, quarter and semester counts, and the graduation date status.
heroSummary: Dysart students begin the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, August 4, 2027, and the last day of school is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Recess is November 22–26, Winter Break is December 20–January 3, and Spring Break is March 13–17. Monday early dismissal begins August 9 and applies on Mondays when school is in session. The reviewed PDF lists Graduation Day as TBD.
calendarNotes: The official Dysart 2027–28 school calendar lists 180 student days. K–8 quarter counts are 47, 38, 47, and 48 days; high school semesters are 85 and 95 days. Early release does not work the same way for every grade level: Mondays when school is in session, K–8 conference days, high school final-exam days, and semester-end dates use separate schedules.

customSections.label: Schedule Changes Families Should Know About
customSections.content: Early release does not work the same way for every grade level. Students are dismissed early on Mondays when school is in session for teacher professional development. K–8 students also have early release for conferences on October 7–8 and February 3–4. High school students are released early for final exams on December 16–17 and May 24–25. On May 25, K–8 students are also released early for the last day of school.
